title: lock_discipline did not see I/O reached under a lock through a funcall of a special-variable seam (fnn-write-all, fnn-write-range, fnn-read-fd), so any leaf lock could do I/O undetected
notes: Mechanism: fnn-write-all, fnn-write-range and fnn-read-fd reach the syscall by (funcall *fnn-write-syscall* ...) / (funcall *fnn-read-syscall* ...), the defvar'd lambda holding sb-unix:unix-write/-read. The walker's funcall arm handled only env-bound names, parameters and quoted defuns; a global special in head position matched none, produced no event, and the defvar's lambda body is never walked, so the blocking summary of every caller was empty.

Fix: funcall/apply of a global resolves its init form (lambda walked at the call site, #'NAME as a call or leaf); an init that is neither raises a callback event, reported as R2 unresolved when a lock that is not io_ok is held. Teeth in tests/test_lock_discipline_check.py class R2SpecialSeam. New real keys surfaced are filed under LOCK-R2-LIVE-RECONFIGURE-IO, LOCK-R2-COMMIT-INLINE-LOG-IO and LOCK-R2-LOG-WRITE-UNDER-K.
